title: Stochastic Completeness for Landmark Shape Spaces with Induced Metrics
summary: Landmark shape spaces arise from configurations of $n$ distinct landmarks with rigid motions factored out and scale normalized. When equipped with sufficiently regular metrics inherited from right-invariant metrics on diffeomorphism groups, the shape spaces inherit geodesic completeness from geodesics of diffeomorphisms. We now answer the corresponding stochastic question if the Riemannian Brownian motion on landmark shape spaces exists for all time and hence rule out initially distinct landmarks colliding when following a Brownian flow.
